name: Kemps
description: Kemps (also known as Kent or Cash) is a fast-paced partnership card game where teams try to collect four-of-a-kind and signal their partner to call 'Kemps!' The game involves secret signals, quick card exchanges, and trying to intercept opponents' signals.

content.text: Kemps (also known as Kent or Cash) is a fast-paced partnership card game where teams try to collect four-of-a-kind and signal their partner to call 'Kemps!' The game involves secret signals, quick card exchanges, and trying to intercept opponents' signals.

Kemps is a relatively modern American card game that emerged in the 20th century. The exact origin is unclear, but it has been popular in the United States since at least the mid-1900s. The game is also known as Kent in some regions.

Minimum Players: 4
Maximum Players: 6+ (in teams of 2)
Optimal Players: 4
Partnerships: Yes (teams of 2, partners sit opposite)

Type: Standard 52-card deck (2 decks for 8+ players)
Number of Decks: 1 (or 2 for larger groups)
Jokers: No

Standard 52-card deck
Table space for 4 face-up cards

Cards per Player: 4
Dealing Pattern: 4 cards to each player
Center: 4 cards dealt face-up in the middle
